data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were $1,009.6m. Prior-year development during 2020 resulted in a gross strengthening of approximately $130.2m (12.9% of opening reserves). Management attributes the adverse prior-year development to a combination of factors: COVID-19 pandemic effects, natural catastrophe activity (notably US hurricanes Laura and Delta), an extensive review of older case files and IBNR recalibration in long-tail classes, and a series of adverse US court rulings. The most affected classes included professional indemnity/management & transactional liability and certain financial institutions/miscellaneous liability exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: COVID-19 had a full year impact of $29m adding 6% to the combined ratio.
It was also another active year for natural catastrophes with US hurricanes Laura and Delta in particular impacting the Syndicate albeit to a level broadly in line with expectations.
Moreover, the Syndicate was required to strengthen reserves primarily in its Professional Indemnity, Financial Institutions, Miscellaneous and Management & Transactional Liability classes.

The combination of an extensive review of old case files by the newly strengthened team of in-house claims experts, and a series of unexpected adverse US court rulings, contributed a further $53m of losses and 11% to the combined ratio.
The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of ($53,039,944) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2019: deterioration $11,141,881).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was calculated from the published gross claims development (claims triangle) because the movement note and narrative only explicitly stated a net prior-year deterioration ($53.04m). The triangle excluded the aggregated '2010 & prior' column per guidance. Amounts are reported in the syndicate's reporting currency (USD). Field names include '_gbp_m' per specification but figures are native currency (USD) millions. No explicit gross prior-year aggregate movement was stated in narrative; triangle-based calculation used (confidence 0.8).
